Start date: 1599-12-18.  
Subtract 31 weeks = 217 days.

Step back:  
Dec 18 minus 18 days → Nov 30.  
Nov 30 has 30 days, so minus 30 more days → Oct 31.  
Remaining days: 221 − 48 = 173 days earlier from Oct 31.  

Oct 31 back 31 days → Sep 30.  
Sep 30 back 30 days → Aug 31.  
Aug 31 back 31 days → Jul 31.  
Jul 31 back 31 days → Jun 30.  
Jun 30 back 30 days → May 31.  
May 31 back 1 more day → May 30.  

Days counted: 18+30+31+30+31+31+30+1 = 202 days, need 221, so 19 days left.  
May 30 back 19 days → May 11.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1599-05-11
